issue_request: FHIR-22484 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction asking that the Address-typed ParticipantContractable.active/ParticipantContactable.active element be renamed to ParticipantContractable.address.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied by lloyd-changes commit 5a23b840ab, the same implementation path as FHIR-24677. That commit changed the participantcontactable spreadsheet row from ParticipantContactable.active to ParticipantContactable.address.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists participantcontactable in the active [logical] section, so the spreadsheet is current build-scope source. Related same-change-family issues FHIR-24677 and FHIR-37872 have already been represented on the combined branch. Current source uses ParticipantContactable.address for the element and search parameter path, uses title-neutral address wording, and exact searches found no stale active-named ParticipantContactable element in current source.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The audit commit records that the requested rename is already present in authoritative current source.
